topic: the version of you nobody sees
lines: The one who gets up when it's still *dark.*
Who keeps going after everyone else has gone to *sleep.*
Who fights battles they never *talk* about.
They don't see the nights you almost *gave up.*
That hidden version of you is the *foundation.*
Every quiet sacrifice is a brick in something *bigger.*
The one doing the work *nobody* claps for.
One day, everyone will see the *building.*
#And you'll know exactly what it's *standing* on.
end: Send this to someone who works in silence.

post.title: The Version of You Nobody Sees
post.caption: Every quiet sacrifice is a brick in something bigger. Keep going. 🌙
post.first_comment: Type 'I SEE YOU' for someone who needs it 👇
